name: YOUSEEME
author: SAMIR KOLEILAT

sections.description:
YouPay – The All-in-One Next-Gen Payment Solution
Accept card payments, instant transfers, and crypto transactions — all from a single, powerful platform.
YouPay helps your business grow by offering customers more ways to pay, at the lowest rates on the market.

Card Payments – Lowest Fees, Instant Processing
Accept Visa and Mastercard payments instantly, at industry-leading low rates.
Offer your customers a smooth and secure checkout experience while reducing your transaction costs.

Key benefits:
– Lowest fees on the market – keep more of your revenue.
– Instant processing – no waiting time for settlements.
– Enhanced customer experience – fast, reliable, and frictionless.

Instant Bank Transfers – Fast & Free
Empower your customers to pay directly from their bank accounts in just seconds — no cards, no intermediaries, no fees.

Key benefits:
– Zero fees for merchants and customers.
– Instant confirmation – funds available immediately.
– Ideal for local and European payments.

Crypto Payments – Borderless & Fee-Free
Accept crypto payments from anywhere in the world — no conversion fees, no restrictions, and instant settlement in euros.

Key benefits:
– Reach global customers with no FX costs.
– No payment restrictions across countries.
– Secure blockchain transactions with full transparency.

Smart, Secure, and Business-Ready
– User-Friendly Dashboard: Simple setup and intuitive design for both merchants and customers.
– Advanced Encryption: All transactions are encrypted, minimizing fraud and ensuring compliance.
– Customizable Fees: Set your own commission rates between 1% and 2%, giving you full control over your margins.
– Multi-Language & Multi-Currency Ready: Perfect for global businesses operating across the EEA.
– Dedicated Support: Our team is available to assist with setup, integration, and technical questions.

Why Choose YouPay?
– One platform for cards, bank transfers, and crypto.
– Lowest rates and zero hidden fees.
– Instant, secure, and compliant across the European Economic Area.
– Backed by Youseeme, a regulated financial entity trusted across Europe.

Regulatory Information
Youseeme is registered with the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) in the Financial Agents Register under number 92083, and operates as an Electronic Money Distributor (EMD) appointed by Treezor, also registered with the PRA under number 63512.
In France, Youseeme is registered as a Digital Asset Service Provider (DASP) under number E2022-50, a designation granted by the French Financial Markets Authority (AMF).

Note: YouPay by Youseeme supports EUR transactions across all European Economic Area (EEA) countries.

Advantages

YouPay – Powering Seamless B2B Payments Across All Methods

YouPay empowers businesses to accept payments through bank cards, instant transfers, and cryptocurrencies — all from one unified solution.
Whether your customers prefer traditional banking, digital wallets, or crypto, YouPay ensures a frictionless, secure, and cost-efficient payment experience.

Recommendations

To start accepting payments with YouPay, you can:
Create a free account on our exchange platform (Youseeme Crypto) to generate your crypto wallet and public address for payment collection.
Or simply contact our support team at contact@youseeme.pro for personalized onboarding and integration assistance.
sections.installation:
Prerequisites
To install and configure WooCommerce YouPay, you will need:
– An active WooCommerce store (WordPress 5.8 or higher).
– A Youseeme / YouPay merchant account (free to create).
– A valid EUR IBAN for instant transfer settlements.
– Optional: a crypto wallet if you wish to accept crypto payments directly.

Installation Instructions

Bring your payment experience to the next level — follow these simple steps to install YouPay and start accepting card, instant transfer, and crypto payments in minutes.

Step 1 – Install the YouPay Plugin

1- Log in to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
2- Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
3- Search for YouPay.
4- Click Install Now, then wait for the installation to complete.
5- Once done, click Activate to enable the plugin immediately — or activate it later via Plugins → Installed Plugins.

Step 2 – Configure YouPay in WooCommerce

1- Go to WooCommerce → Settings.
2- Open the Payments tab.
3- You’ll see two YouPay options in the list of payment methods:
4- Youseeme – Cryptocurrencies (for crypto payments).
5- Youseeme – IBAN (for instant bank transfers).
6- You can activate and configure either (or both) according to your business needs.

Crypto Payment Setup

1- Activate / Deactivate
– Check the box “Activate payment by cryptocurrencies” to enable crypto payments.
2- API Key
– Request your API Key by contacting our support team at contact@youseeme.pro,
or create a free account on Youseeme Crypto to generate your own merchant wallet
and obtain your API credentials.
3-Commission (%)
– Define your commission rate (1–2%) according to your business model.
4-Accepted Cryptocurrencies
– Click “+ Add Crypto”, select the cryptocurrencies you wish to accept (e.g.,
Bitcoin, Ethereum, etc.),
then copy and paste your public wallet address into the address field.
– To remove a crypto, simply select it in the list and click “Remove selected crypto”.
5-Save Configuration
– Once done, click Save Changes to apply your setup.

Note: After saving, a QR code for each cryptocurrency will automatically appear on your payment page — enabling fast, secure, and borderless payments.

IBAN Payment Setup (Instant Transfers)
1- In WooCommerce → Payments, select “Youseeme – Pay using IBAN.”
2- Click “+ Add IBAN” to enter your bank details:
– Bank Name
– IBAN
– BIC / SWIFT

Once saved, YouPay automatically generates a QR Code linked to your IBAN.
This allows your customers to pay instantly via express SEPA transfer — no card, no fees, no delay.

Pro Tip:

You can open a dedicated IBAN business account with Youseeme Finance.
This allows you to manage your online sales separately from your main bank account.
Learn more on our website: youseeme.fr.

What Is the QR Code For?

When paying by IBAN, the QR Code simplifies and accelerates payment:
customers simply scan it with their banking app (EPC QR Code protocol – European Payments Council).
Funds are transferred instantly via SEPA, and no card commission fees (Visa / Mastercard) are charged.
More details available on the EPC QR Code Standard.

Need Help?

If you encounter any issue or need assistance with configuration, our support team is here to help: contact@youseeme.pro

Frequently Asked Questions
Does YouPay support recurring payments (subscriptions)?
Yes, YouPay supports recurring payments through WooCommerce Subscriptions.
Where can I get support or connect with other users?
You can reach out to our team or other merchants directly in the YouPay Plugin Forum.
What is the QR Code used for when paying by IBAN?
The QR Code enables instant SEPA bank transfers by simply scanning it with the client’s banking app.
It uses the EPC QR Code Protocol to eliminate card fees and accelerate payment confirmation.

Upgrade Notice

Automatic updates work seamlessly.
However, as always, we recommend backing up your WordPress site before performing any major updates.
